summary: Frontend-only Playwright testing (1920x1080 + 768px) of the new chat workspace, preview, collapsible workspace sidebar, and Settings > Model Providers. Everything worked: intro splash, home prompt -> workspace auto-build (msg-user/msg-run, Build passou, iframe, v1 de 1, 'Atualizado agora'), busy state (composer-stop, chat-busy, preview-loading), stop -> run-stopped + send re-enabled + no late version, empty-state suggestions fill and focus the composer (reached via GitHub import), PLAN mode -> 5 numbered steps -> plan-execute -> rebuilding overlay -> v2 de 2, pv-back/forward switch the iframe content, copy/like/dislike/retry actions, model picker, Tarefas list (done/done/stopped), device sizes (1196/820/390px), reload, new tab (blob URL), code view + copy, ws-side collapses to a 60px rail (labels hidden, rail items work, handle toggles, saved in localStorage across reload), provider modal (12+custom, search, empty search result), anthropic connect with validation/eye toggle/masked key/toast/agent model options, Ollama (URL prefilled, no key), custom provider validation chain, tile menu test/replace/remove, closing the menu or modal by clicking outside. I found and fixed 2 bugs.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED: attachments were never added. The onChange read e.target.files inside a lazy setState updater, but e.target.value='' had already cleared the FileList by the time the updater ran, so 0 chips appeared.
FIXED: when opened via provider-menu-replace for Ollama, the base URL field was empty because pick() (the only place that prefills it) never runs for initialKey, so the user had to retype the URL

issues: The preview pane is completely hidden and there is no toggle to switch between chat and preview. ws-side is hidden too, so tablet/mobile users can't see the preview at all.
Console shows 404s from cdn.simpleicons.org for the openai, groq and together slugs. A fallback to favicon kicks in, but the console is noisy; map these slugs to the favicon directly
Custom provider tiles have no 'Trocar chave' option (meta is null), so changing their key means remove + re-add
The 'Trocar chave' title and button are shown for Ollama, which has no key; label them by URL instead
The test-OK badge (provider-test-ok) stays on the tile after the key is replaced, so it is stale
Toast timers are not reset: when toasts come quickly, the first timeout hides the second toast early
Project name is the first 3 words of the prompt (e.g. 'Landing page para', 'Painel financeiro com'), which reads cut off

action_items: Add a chat/preview switch (or stacked layout) for widths <=1024px so the preview can be reached on tablet/mobile
Avoid simpleicons slugs that return 404 (openai, groq, together)
Allow key/URL replacement for custom providers and label the Ollama replace flow as 'URL', not 'chave'
Clear the tile test result after the key is replaced, and reset the toast timer on each flash
Improve how the project name is derived from the prompt
critical_code_review_comments: WorkspaceLayout.onBuildDone calls setIdx inside the setVersions updater (a side effect in an updater). It works now, but it's fragile under StrictMode/concurrent rendering; compute the index outside
ChatPane.stop() clears ALL timers, including a pending plan timer; plans are force-marked ready, which is fine for now
ChatPane retry calls startBuild without a user message, so Tarefas shows a duplicate prompt with no matching user bubble (acceptable)
AddProviderModal replace flow does not prefill an existing custom label/models/baseUrl from stored metadata

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows pass after the 2 tester fixes

seed_data_creation: None. Providers are in-memory (mock repository); clear localStorage hall.ws.side for a clean sidebar state
context_for_next_testing_agent: Wait 4.5s for the splash. Empty chat state is reachable via import-github-btn -> gh-connect-btn -> first gh-repo-*. Use page.expect_file_chooser on composer-attach for attachments. The custom provider tile testid is provider-custom-<base36>. Settings: sb-user-btn -> sb-user-settings on home, or side-settings-geral in the workspace.
rca of the issue: 1) Attachments: React setState updaters run lazily during render; by then e.target.value='' had reset input.files, so Array.from(e.target.files) was empty. Fix: capture the names synchronously before setState. 2) Ollama replace: the baseUrl default comes only from pick(); the initialKey path sets picked via the useState initializer and skips pick(). Fix: useState initial value depends on initialKey.
